proof_rule: A retry needs a listed transient cause, proved no effect or no commit, a repeatable effect graph, stable logical delivery identity, and remaining attempt/deadline budget. A timeout or idempotency key alone proves none of these.

cases.observation: read fails before any write or external dispatch
cases.semantic_outcome: Unavailable or TimedOut by cause, never OutcomeUnknown
cases.automatic_retry: only if the enclosing operation is proved repeatable and within its retry budget
cases.note: Generated query-only routes map listed structured SQLite busy/locked and PostgreSQL connection-closed causes to 503 read_unavailable, without replay. Native SQLite exclusive locking and PostgreSQL dropped read responses pass; message-only, SQL defect, cancellation-only, cardinality and unknown-outcome negative cases are covered. Deadline-aware TimedOut, opaque/action paths, provider/job integration and independent runtime review remain open.
